sources.title: WikiMind — AI-powered living wiki builder
sources.snippet: WikiMind turns your raw notes into structured knowledge bases. Have AI conversations grounded entirely in your own content and watch your wiki grow smarter over time.

sources.title: 9 Best 3B Local LLM Model (Open Source) - Sci Fi Logic
sources.snippet: This 3B model, trained on a massive 1 trillion tokens, showcases the potential of compact models to achieve impressive performance, paving the way for personal AI assistants on local devices, ensuring privacy and autonomy.

sources.title: Weibo's VibeThinker-3B Challenges AI Benchmarks with Tiny Model, Big ...
sources.snippet: A 3 billion parameter language model from Sina Weibo is making waves by matching or exceeding the performance of much larger models, sparking debate over the future of AI benchmarks.
